role_source: OpenDota dotaconstants bf193a550f778dec35debf4d71d05a86bebcc418; descriptive role labels, not matchup ratings
hero_summary_zh: 风行者身法轻灵多变，总是在寻找出手的角度。她要么张弓射出强力致命的一箭，要么将敌人束缚在一起，向他们射出箭雨，风行者永远都是那么雷厉风行。
hero_summary_en: Evasive and swift, the nimble Windranger is always seeking the right angle to attack. Whether she's clearing the way with a draw of her deadly powershot, or shackling enemies together to pepper them with arrows, she's always on the move.

abilities.name: windrunner_shackleshot
abilities.description_zh: 将目标束缚在正对其后的一个敌方单位或树上。若目标后面没有其它敌方单位或树木，则眩晕时间减少至%fail_stun_duration%秒。
abilities.description_en: Shackles the target to an enemy unit or tree in a line directly behind it.  If no unit or tree is present, the stun duration is reduced to %fail_stun_duration%.
notes_zh: 该技能可以将两个敌人一起束缚，使他们同时眩晕。
束缚击能将目标束缚在身后最多%shackle_distance%距离的敌方单位或树木。
notes_en: This spell can shackle two enemies together, stunning them both.
Can shackle the target to an enemy unit or tree at most %shackle_distance% behind the target.
facet_text_en: Shackleshot applies to all units and trees behind the target unit and grants Windranger bonus attack damage for each additional shackled unit and tree. Creeps and trees grant less bonus damage.
facet_text_zh: 束缚击会对目标单位身后的所有单位和树木施加，每个额外束缚的单位和树木都会使风行者获得攻击力加成。非英雄单位和树木提供的攻击力加成较少。

abilities.name: windrunner_powershot
abilities.description_zh: 持续施法 - 风行者为她的弓蓄力，射出一支强力的箭矢，最长可蓄力%abilitychanneltime%秒，其间可以打断蓄力，蓄力时间越长，箭矢伤害越高。这支箭会对穿过的所有敌方单位造成伤害和减速效果，并破坏树木。每伤害一个单位，箭矢的伤害和减速效果都会降低。
abilities.description_en: CHANNELED - Windranger charges her bow for up to %abilitychanneltime% second for a single powerful shot, which deals more damage the longer it is charged. The arrow damages and slows enemies' movement speed along its path. For each enemy that Powershot hits, its damage and slow is reduced.
notes_zh: 强力击将摧毁作用范围内的树木。
notes_en: Powershot will destroy trees in its area of effect.
facet_text_en: Enemy heroes hit are executed if below a health threshold. The execute threshold is based on the arrow's power.
facet_text_zh: 被击中的敌方英雄血量低于临界值就会被秒杀。秒杀血量是基于箭矢的威力。

abilities.name: windrunner_windrun
abilities.description_zh: 提升移动速度，并闪避一切物理攻击。
abilities.description_en: Increases movement speed and adds evasion from all physical attacks.

abilities.name: windrunner_gale_force
abilities.description_zh: 以矢量为目标。召唤出一阵强风，将目标区域内所有敌人朝目标方向推去。
abilities.description_en: Vector Targeted. Summons a strong wind that pushes all enemies in the target area towards the target direction.

abilities.name: windrunner_focusfire
abilities.description_zh: 风行者受风的引领，攻击敌方单位或建筑的攻击速度增加%bonus_attack_speed%，但是攻击力降低。不过次级物品效果的额外伤害不会降低。
abilities.description_en: Windranger channels the wind to gain %bonus_attack_speed% additional attack speed against a single enemy unit or structure, though with a reduction to her attack damage.  Extra damage from secondary item effects is not reduced.
notes_zh: 下达停在原地的指令会暂停风行者的攻击。
风行者在攻击时可以移动。
notes_en: Issuing a Hold Position command will pause Windranger's attacks.
facet_text_en: Focus Fire no longer requires a target, instead firing at random enemies within Windranger's attack range + %bonus_range%. Fires a fixed number of attacks per second, and can only hit the same enemy every 4 shots. Prioritizes Heroes.
facet_text_zh: 集中火力不再需要施法目标，而是对风行者攻击距离 + %bonus_range%范围内的随机敌人发动攻击。每秒发动固定次数的攻击，并且每4箭才会击中一次同个敌人。以英雄优先。

abilities.name: windrunner_tailwind
abilities.description_zh:
施放技能会召唤一阵顺风，向风行者提供短时间的移动速度爆发。移动速度加成在顺风持续时间的半途开始逐渐衰减。

被动提升风行者的移动速度上限。
abilities.description_en:
Using an ability conjures a stacking Tailwind that gives Windranger a brief burst of movement speed. Movement speed bonus gradually starts fading halfway through the Tailwind duration.

Passively increases Windranger's max movement speed.

scepter_loc.en: Attacks grant Tailwind. Tailwind lasts longer and is undispellable.
scepter_loc.zh: 攻击也会提供顺风效果。顺风的持续时间更长，并且不可驱散。

talents_raw.name: special_bonus_unique_windranger_7
talents_raw.name_loc: Powershot Executes Enemy Heroes Under {s:bonus_max_execute_threshold}% Max HP
talents_raw.desc_loc: Execute Threshold ranges from {s:bonus_min_execute_threshold}% to {s:bonus_max_execute_threshold}% Max HP based on the arrow's power.

talents_raw.name: special_bonus_unique_windranger_2
talents_raw.name_loc: Focus Fire Kills Advance Cooldown by {s:bonus_cooldown_reduction_per_kill}s
